audit_items.proof_trace: TxPool filter enforces block gas limit (~30M) not the EIP-7825 per-tx cap (16.7M). Block validator enforces the cap via GasLimitCapTxValidator. When EIP-7825 activates, txs with gasLimit in [16.7M, 30M] pass mempool admission but fail block validation.
audit_items.attack_scenario: Attacker floods mempool with txs having gasLimit=20M. These bypass GasLimitTxFilter, consume mempool slots and propagate to peers, but are un-mineable (rejected by GasLimitCapTxValidator). DoS: waste network bandwidth and mempool capacity with invalid transactions.
